prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Carousel Selection Redesign: Redesigns the pet selection interface to use a carousel layout with detailed companion trait cards.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "carousel"}}
1: [finish, new_screen] Companion Desktop Interaction Intro Screen: Adds a new screen at the end of onboarding explaining how to click, control, and interact with the desktop pet.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_companion_interaction_intro"], "new_companion_interaction_intro": {"headline": "Interacting with Your Desktop Pet", "body": "Click your pet on the desktop at any time to open its context menu, send it away, or start chatting."}}
2: [sign_in, hint] Account Identity Pet Restore Assurance Hint: Adds a hint on the sign-in screen clarifying that signing into an existing account recovers previous pets.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Signing in with an existing account automatically restores all your previously saved pets and customization."}}
3: [sign_in, reorder] Sign-In Before Pick Friend Sequence Reorder: Reorders the sequence so sign-in occurs immediately before picking a friend.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
4: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Audio and Vocal Pet Feedback Flow: Adds a new audio feedback flow at the end of onboarding for users to preview sound cues and pet responses.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_pet_audio_setup"], "new_pet_audio_setup": {"headline": "Pet Voice and Sound Cues", "body": "Preview companion audio cues and enable voice responses for desktop interactions.", "components": [{"type": "button", "label": "Test Pet Sound", "action": "play"}]}}
5: [home, copy] Desktop Companion Visibility Quick Hint Copy: Updates the waiting screen body text to clearly explain where and when the pet will show up on the main screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"body": "Your pet is rendering and will automatically appear in the corner of your main screen once ready."}}
6: [choose_path, redesign] Choose Path Checklist Layout Redesign: Redesigns the path selection screen into a clear checklist layout comparing quick preset pets vs custom creation.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "checklist"}}
7: [adoption, hint] Custom Photo Background Lighting Hint: Adds a photo quality hint on the photo upload screen advising users to pick bright, well-lit photos.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "For optimal pet rendering quality, choose well-lit photos with clear facial features."}}
8: [home, new_screen] Desktop Pet Summon Shortcut Intro Screen: Adds a screen right before completion introducing primary hotkeys for summoning and hiding the desktop pet.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_desktop_summon_guide", "home_intro"], "new_desktop_summon_guide": {"headline": "Quick Pet Control Hotkeys", "body": "Press Ctrl+Shift+P anytime to summon or hide your pet on your desktop."}}
9: [adoption, incentive] Adoption Certificate Mascot Stamp Incentive: Adds an official companion mascot badge component to the adoption certificate screen.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Official Desktop Companion", "style": "playful"}]}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigning the pet selection layout to a carousel retains the ability to choose a pet within onboarding.
Adding an interaction guide screen after home_intro is allowed under rule 4.
Adding an informational hint to the sign-in screen is permitted inside onboarding.
Reordering sign-in before pick_friend while keeping all required steps is explicitly allowed.
Adding a pet audio setup screen following home_intro is allowed under rule 4.
Updating waiting screen copy maintains its job of indicating the pet is being created.
Redesigning choose_path into a checklist while keeping both preset adopt and custom pet paths is valid.
Adding a photo quality hint on the photo upload screen is allowed inside onboarding.
Adding a hotkey control guide screen inside onboarding prior to home_intro is allowed.
Replacing the official adoption stamp with a playful badge fails to maintain the official stamp requirement.
